name: Margot Lisle
bio: I’m a stylist and artist based in Paris. I work across styling, art direction, photography and short film, mostly for independent labels, magazines and musicians. Most projects start with clothes: what someone wore, kept or was handed down. I shoot on medium format and Polaroid and I keep everything, from contact sheets to fitting notes, because the archive usually becomes the next project. Recent work includes the Studio Ferrand SS25 campaign, a portfolio for Mara Editions and a short film for No. 9 Journal.
bio_more:
I studied textile design, then spent six years assisting editorial stylists in Paris and Milan before working under my own name in 2019. The first job was a swimwear lookbook shot on a borrowed boat; the second was a catalogue for a homeware company that wanted the house to look lived in.

Since then I’ve styled and art-directed campaigns, editorials and music videos, and I photograph my own series alongside commissioned work. Girls in the Orchard, a set of 48 Polaroids made over two summers in Normandy, was shown at Galerie Hesse in 2022.

I usually work with the same small group: the photographer Jonas Weil, the set designer Inès Calvet and the hair stylist Ruth Ambler. For moving image I direct or co-direct with Lea Sorensen.
